import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Compare to diff
print("\nDiff for TSPAN6:")
print(diff[diff['id'] == 'TSPAN6'])
# Try different comparisons
print("\nPossible log2FC values for TSPAN6:")
print("CohortB - CohortA (all):", tsp['CohortB_ctrl_mean'].iloc[0] - tsp['CohortA_ctrl_mean'].iloc[0])
print("CohortB - CohortA (all, mean of all samples):", (tsp[cohort_bctrl+cohort_bsi].mean(axis=1).iloc[0] - tsp[cohort_actrl+cohort_asi].mean(axis=1).iloc[0]))

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
# Check the Excel differential analysis distribution
diff = pd.read_excel('inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx', sheet_name=0)
# Compute -log10(pvalue) and check ranges
diff['neg_log10_p'] = -np.log10(diff['pvalue'].clip(lower=1e-300))
print("log2FC stats:")
print(f"  Min: {diff['log2FoldChange'].min():.3f}")
print(f"  Max: {diff['log2FoldChange'].max():.3f}")
print(f"  Median: {diff['log2FoldChange'].median():.3f}")
print(f"  Mean: {diff['log2FoldChange'].mean():.3f}")
print("\nneg_log10_p stats:")
print(f"  Min: {diff['neg_log10_p'].min():.3f}")
print(f"  Max: {diff['neg_log10_p'].max():.3f}")
# Count significant genes
sig_up = ((diff['log2FoldChange'] > 1) & (diff['pvalue'] < 0.05)).sum()
sig_down = ((diff['log2FoldChange'] < -1) & (diff['pvalue'] < 0.05)).sum()
print(f"\nSignificant UP (log2FC>1, p<0.05): {sig_up}")
print(f"Significant DOWN (log2FC<-1, p<0.05): {sig_down}")
# Try to verify the log2FC calculation - what comparison gives these values?
# Sample IDs suggest group1=CohortB vs group2=CohortA perhaps?
# Or it could be ctrl vs si within each group
# Let's check by computing each comparison
df = pd.read_csv('inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv', header=[0, 1], skipinitialspace=True)
df.columns = ['id'] + [c[1] for c in df.columns[1:]]
cohort_actrl = ['CohortActrl1', 'CohortActrl2', 'CohortActrl4']
cohort_asi = ['CohortAsi1', 'CohortAsi2', 'CohortAsi5']
cohort_bctrl = ['CohortBctrl1', 'CohortBctrl2', 'CohortBctrl4']
cohort_bsi = ['CohortBsi1', 'CohortBsi2', 'CohortBsi3']
# Compute means (data appears already log2-transformed, e.g. log2(TPM+1))
df['cohort_a_ctrl'] = df[cohort_actrl].mean(axis=1)
df['cohort_a_si'] = df[cohort_asi].mean(axis=1)
df['cohort_b_ctrl'] = df[cohort_bctrl].mean(axis=1)
df['cohort_b_si'] = df[cohort_bsi].mean(axis=1)
# Drop duplicates (TSPAN6 appears twice in CSV)
df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['id'])
# Merge with diff
m = df.merge(diff, on='id', how='inner')
print(f"\nMerged: {len(m)} genes")
# Check correlations of different log2FC calculations
m['fc_cohort_b_minus_cohort_a'] = (m['cohort_b_ctrl'] + m['cohort_b_si'])/2 - (m['cohort_a_ctrl'] + m['cohort_a_si'])/2
m['fc_si_minus_ctrl'] = ((m['cohort_a_si'] + m['cohort_b_si'])/2 - (m['cohort_a_ctrl'] + m['cohort_b_ctrl'])/2)
m['fc_max_diff'] = m[['cohort_a_ctrl','cohort_a_si','cohort_b_ctrl','cohort_b_si']].max(axis=1) - m[['cohort_a_ctrl','cohort_a_si','cohort_b_ctrl','cohort_b_si']].min(axis=1)
print(f"\nCorrelation of provided log2FC with various comparisons:")
print(f"  cohort_b-cohort_a mean: {m['log2FoldChange'].corr(m['fc_cohort_b_minus_cohort_a']):.4f}")
print(f"  si-ctrl mean: {m['log2FoldChange'].corr(m['fc_si_minus_ctrl']):.4f}")
print(f"  max-min:      {m['log2FoldChange'].corr(m['fc_max_diff']):.4f}")
# Check distribution of max-min vs provided log2FC for TSPAN6
print("\nFirst few genes comparison:")
print(m[['id','log2FoldChange','fc_cohort_b_minus_cohort_a','fc_si_minus_ctrl','fc_max_diff']].head(5))

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(dplyr)
  library(readxl)
  library(patchwork)
  library(RColorBrewer)
})
# 1. Load the expression matrix ---------------------------------------------
# First two rows are headers (#group, group1/2) and (id, sample names)
expr_raw <- read.csv(
  "inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv",
  header = FALSE,
  skip = 2,
  check.names = FALSE
)
sample_names <- read.csv(
  "inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv",
  header = FALSE,
  skip = 1,
  nrows = 1
)
sample_names <- as.character(unlist(sample_names))
group_names  <- as.character(unlist(read.csv(
  "inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv",
  header = FALSE,
  skip = 0,
  nrows = 1
)))
colnames(expr_raw) <- c("id", sample_names)
expr <- expr_raw[!duplicated(expr_raw$id), ]
rownames(expr) <- expr$id
expr$id <- NULL
cat("Expression matrix:", nrow(expr), "genes x", ncol(expr), "samples\n")
cat("Samples:", paste(colnames(expr), collapse = ", "), "\n")
# 2. Load the pre-computed differential analysis (CohortB vs CohortA) ---------------
diff_df <- read_excel("inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx")
cat("\nDifferential analysis:", nrow(diff_df), "genes\n")
cat("Columns:", paste(colnames(diff_df), collapse = ", "), "\n")
# 3. Compute per-cell-type siRNA vs ctrl log2 fold changes --------------------
cohort_a_ctrl <- c("CohortActrl1", "CohortActrl2", "CohortActrl4")
cohort_a_si   <- c("CohortAsi1",   "CohortAsi2",  "CohortAsi5")
cohort_b_ctrl <- c("CohortBctrl1", "CohortBctrl2", "CohortBctrl4")
cohort_b_si   <- c("CohortBsi1",   "CohortBsi2",  "CohortBsi3")
# Values in the CSV are already log2(TPM+1), so log2FC = mean(si) - mean(ctrl)
log2fc_cohort_a <- rowMeans(expr[, cohort_a_si]) - rowMeans(expr[, cohort_a_ctrl])
log2fc_cohort_b <- rowMeans(expr[, cohort_b_si]) - rowMeans(expr[, cohort_b_ctrl])
# Welch t-test per gene for each cell type (n = 3 vs 3)
t_pv_cohort_a <- apply(expr, 1, function(x) tryCatch(
  t.test(x[cohort_a_si], x[cohort_a_ctrl])$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_
))
t_pv_cohort_b <- apply(expr, 1, function(x) tryCatch(
  t.test(x[cohort_b_si], x[cohort_b_ctrl])$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_
))
diag_df <- data.frame(
  id         = names(log2fc_cohort_a),
  log2fc_cohort_a = as.numeric(log2fc_cohort_a),
  log2fc_cohort_b = as.numeric(log2fc_cohort_b),
  p_cohort_a      = as.numeric(t_pv_cohort_a),
  p_cohort_b      = as.numeric(t_pv_cohort_b),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_p_cohort_a = -log10(pmax(p_cohort_a, 1e-300)),
    neg_log10_p_cohort_b = -log10(pmax(p_cohort_b, 1e-300)),
    sig_cohort_a = p_cohort_a < 0.05 & abs(log2fc_cohort_a) > 0.5,
    sig_cohort_b = p_cohort_b < 0.05 & abs(log2fc_cohort_b) > 0.5
  ) %>%
  left_join(diff_df, by = "id")
cat("\nDiagonal volcano data ready:", nrow(diag_df), "genes\n")
cat("Significant in CohortA only :", sum(diag_df$sig_cohort_a & !diag_df$sig_cohort_b), "\n")
cat("Significant in CohortB only :", sum(!diag_df$sig_cohort_a & diag_df$sig_cohort_b), "\n")
cat("Significant in both    :", sum(diag_df$sig_cohort_a &  diag_df$sig_cohort_b), "\n")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(dplyr)
  library(readxl)
  library(patchwork)
  library(RColorBrewer)
})
# Inspect header rows directly
hdr1 <- readLines("inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv", n = 2)
cat("Row 1:", hdr1[1], "\n")
cat("Row 2:", hdr1[2], "\n")
# Read the expression matrix starting from row 3 (gene data), with sample names from row 2
expr_raw <- read.csv(
  "inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv",
  header           = FALSE,
  skip             = 2,
  check.names      = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
# Read sample names from row 2 (just the sample columns)
sample_hdr <- read.csv(
  "inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv",
  header = FALSE,
  skip   = 1,
  nrows  = 1,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
sample_names <- as.character(unlist(sample_hdr))
cat("Number of sample columns (incl. id):", length(sample_names), "\n")
cat("Number of expr_raw columns        :", ncol(expr_raw), "\n")
# Both should be 13 (id + 12 samples)
if (length(sample_names) != ncol(expr_raw)) {
  # Align lengths
  if (length(sample_names) > ncol(expr_raw)) {
    sample_names <- sample_names[seq_len(ncol(expr_raw))]
  } else {
    # Pad if needed
    sample_names <- c(sample_names, rep(NA, ncol(expr_raw) - length(sample_names)))
  }
}
colnames(expr_raw) <- sample_names
# Drop duplicate gene rows (TSPAN6 appears twice)
expr <- expr_raw[!duplicated(expr_raw$id), ]
rownames(expr) <- expr$id
expr_mat <- as.matrix(expr[, -1, drop = FALSE])
cat("Final expression matrix:", nrow(expr_mat), "genes x", ncol(expr_mat), "samples\n")
cat("Samples:", paste(colnames(expr_mat), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# 2. Load the pre-computed differential analysis (CohortB vs CohortA) ---------------
diff_df <- read_excel("inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx")
cat("Differential analysis:", nrow(diff_df), "genes\n")
cat("Columns:", paste(colnames(diff_df), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
# 3. Per-cell-type siRNA vs ctrl ---------------------------------------------
cohort_a_ctrl <- c("CohortActrl1", "CohortActrl2", "CohortActrl4")
cohort_a_si   <- c("CohortAsi1",   "CohortAsi2",  "CohortAsi5")
cohort_b_ctrl <- c("CohortBctrl1", "CohortBctrl2", "CohortBctrl4")
cohort_b_si   <- c("CohortBsi1",   "CohortBsi2",  "CohortBsi3")
# CSV values are already log2(TPM+1), so log2FC = mean(si) - mean(ctrl)
log2fc_cohort_a <- rowMeans(expr_mat[, cohort_a_si]) - rowMeans(expr_mat[, cohort_a_ctrl])
log2fc_cohort_b <- rowMeans(expr_mat[, cohort_b_si]) - rowMeans(expr_mat[, cohort_b_ctrl])
# Welch t-test per gene (n = 3 vs 3)
t_pv_cohort_a <- apply(expr_mat, 1, function(x) tryCatch(
  t.test(x[cohort_a_si], x[cohort_a_ctrl])$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_
))
t_pv_cohort_b <- apply(expr_mat, 1, function(x) tryCatch(
  t.test(x[cohort_b_si], x[cohort_b_ctrl])$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_
))
diag_df <- data.frame(
  id           = rownames(expr_mat),
  log2fc_cohort_a   = as.numeric(log2fc_cohort_a),
  log2fc_cohort_b   = as.numeric(log2fc_cohort_b),
  p_cohort_a        = as.numeric(t_pv_cohort_a),
  p_cohort_b        = as.numeric(t_pv_cohort_b),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_p_cohort_a = -log10(pmax(p_cohort_a, 1e-300)),
    neg_log10_p_cohort_b = -log10(pmax(p_cohort_b, 1e-300)),
    sig_cohort_a         = p_cohort_a < 0.05 & abs(log2fc_cohort_a) > 0.5,
    sig_cohort_b         = p_cohort_b < 0.05 & abs(log2fc_cohort_b) > 0.5,
    direction       = case_when(
      sig_cohort_a & sig_cohort_b ~ "Both",
      sig_cohort_a           ~ "CohortA only",
      sig_cohort_b           ~ "CohortB only",
      TRUE              ~ "NS"
    ),
    direction       = factor(direction, levels = c("Both", "CohortA only", "CohortB only", "NS"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(diff_df, by = "id")
cat("Diagonal volcano data ready:", nrow(diag_df), "genes\n")
cat("CohortA-only significant :", sum(diag_df$direction == "CohortA only"), "\n")
cat("CohortB-only significant :", sum(diag_df$direction == "CohortB only"), "\n")
cat("Both cell types     :", sum(diag_df$direction == "Both"), "\n")

# 4. Build the diagonal volcano plot -----------------------------------------
# Re-use the existing global data frame from the previous cell
# (notebook_execute keeps a single shared R kernel so diag_df is in globalenv)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
# Pick the most "extreme" genes for labelling: largest Euclidean distance from origin
# among the significant ones, plus the strongest cell-type-specific effects
top_labels <- diag_df %>%
  filter(direction != "NS") %>%
  mutate(dist = sqrt(log2fc_cohort_a^2 + log2fc_cohort_b^2)) %>%
  arrange(desc(dist)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 12)
# Color palette (Cell Press style, two-tone)
cols <- c(
  "Both"     = "#D7263D",
  "CohortA only" = "#1B998B",
  "CohortB only" = "#3D5A80",
  "NS"       = "grey85"
)
# Axis limits (symmetric, with padding)
axlim <- max(abs(c(diag_df$log2fc_cohort_a, diag_df$log2fc_cohort_b))) * 1.05
# Main scatter ---------------------------------------------------------------
main <- ggplot(diag_df, aes(x = log2fc_cohort_a, y = log2fc_cohort_b)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = direction, size  = pmin(neg_log10_p_cohort_a + neg_log10_p_cohort_b, 12)),
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.4, 3), guide = "none") +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-axlim, axlim), ylim = c(-axlim, axlim), clip = "off") +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_labels,
    aes(label = id),
    size = 3, max.overlaps = 30, box.padding = 0.3,
    segment.colour = "grey50", segment.size = 0.2
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression("CohortA: siRNA vs control  " * log[2] * " FC"),
    y = expression("CohortB: siRNA vs control  " * log[2] * " FC"),
    title = "Diagonal volcano plot",
    subtitle = "siRNA perturbation response in CohortA vs CohortB cell types\n(diagonal y = x marks genes equally affected in both cell types)"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey30"),
    legend.position = c(0.02, 0.98),
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
# Marginal density on x (top) ------------------------------------------------
top_dens <- ggplot(diag_df, aes(x = log2fc_cohort_a, fill = direction)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.55, colour = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols, guide = "none") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(b = 2))
# Marginal density on y (right) ----------------------------------------------
right_dens <- ggplot(diag_df, aes(x = log2fc_cohort_b, fill = direction)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.55, colour = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols, guide = "none") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(l = 2))
# Compose with patchwork: top density above, right density to the right,
# main scatter filling the centre
design <- "
AAAA#
BBBB#
CCCCD
"
combined <- (top_dens + main + right_dens + plot_spacer()) +
  plot_layout(design = design, widths = c(4, 0.6), heights = c(0.6, 4))
# Save to a PNG file (relative path resolves to notebook session data dir)
out_path <- "diagonal_volcano_plot.png"
ggsave(
  filename = out_path,
  plot     = combined,
  width    = 9, height = 8, dpi = 200, bg = "white"
)
cat("Saved plot to:", out_path, "\n")
cat("File size:", file.info(out_path)$size, "bytes\n")
